title: LINEAR ALGEBRA I
description: Matrix algebra, determinants, systems of linear equations, subspaces, an introductory study of eigenvalues and eigenvectors.All courses used to satisfy MTH prerequisites must be completed with C- or better
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 254 or 254H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 254 and MTH 254H.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: MWF 11am-11:50am in FURM 102 - Joyce Collin Furman Hall 102 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
